== Biography ==
Magdaline was christened 24 Jan 1800 in Kirknewton, Scotland. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-1223|William Glasgow]] and [[Nisbet-3257|Catherine Nisbet]]. <ref> "Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4K-299 : 12 February 2020), Magdaline Glasgow, 1800.</ref>
